'''Conraad Om'wurt''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Beastmaster/Legends|beastmaster]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. By [[3630 BBY]] he became known as the gladiator in the [[Arena Grand]] of [[Zakuul]]. That year, Om'wurt was put up against a newcomer known as "[[Alliance Commander|the Mysterious Stranger]]." During the fight in the Arena, he was assisted by his trained [[K'lor'slug/Legends|K'lor'slug]] [[Chompers the Undying]], but was defeated in the fourth round of the Arena fights.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Conraad Om'wurt appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' as the fourth boss of the "Eternal Championship."<ref name="SWTOR" />
